name: autonomous-project-agent
description: Single-skill autonomous project agent: end-to-end workflow with boot-time constraint loading and resume, plan-preview gate (one approval moment, then unattended), seven-layer security gate including connectivity audit, emulator smoke tests with port-open polling at pre-deployment, deploy verification via HTTP polling, free-tier-first cost analysis, Firebase + React + React Context default stack, reference-mode Anthropic key wiring, test-first phasing, run-state checkpointing, GitHub bootstrap with per-phase PRs and end-of-run CI status polling, anti-pattern self-test catalog, and polling discipline (§27) across all external-state waits. Never auto-merges its own PRs; never auto-promotes dev to prod.
